start_gate: Push this preregistration before arming the empty screen file; direct native power fields have been read back.
assignment: Existing run-tag on/off screen. No manual arm selection. Preserve current leader/difficulty/victory mix and all other flags.

sample.continuations: join by stem; do not count twice
sample.setup_failures: retain as attrition, not a configured game
sample.other_lanes: retain assigned attempts separately; not part of primary execution cohort

primary_question: Do candidate-labelled Coal requests produce accepted paid terms, observed delivered stock and native power in reachable Labs?
readings: raw Coal buy proposals and ceiling
candidate note and actual observed genome
native offer/response/close events and paid terms
plant construction and direct city power fields
native city Science and yield-source text
interpretation: An emitted buy, closable reply or sent acceptance alone is not delivery.
A ceiling and the host pay metric (Gold + 25*GPT) are not verified nominal payments.
Concurrent construction, growth and policy changes prevent attributing a city yield delta solely to Coal.
No default promotion or pooled win-rate inference from this feasibility pilot.
Record exact binary/source/profile hashes. Compare matching revisions and normalized genomes separately; never pool changing builds as a fixed treatment.
Missing telemetry and ambiguous delivery remain unknown, not zero or failure.
stop_rule: After the first eight configured Science game families begun after arming, restore the prior empty screen file. Stop earlier only for a concrete command/finance failure or user steering, retaining all attempts and reason.

power_readback.scope: Direct host power export works at zero demand; this is not a fuel delivery or powered-Lab gain.
